name: How do I choose the right contractor for a foreclosed home renovation?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right contractor for a foreclosed home renovation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choose a contractor with verified hands-on finish carpentry and remodeling experience, active licensing, proper insurance, and a strong local reputation. When evaluating candidates, check for positive ratings with consumer organizations such as the Better Business Bureau and ask to see recent examples of complex interior overhauls. It is beneficial to select a contractor who acts as your direct contact on the job site while coordinating licensed mechanical trades. Ask potential contractors how they uncover concealed defects, handle unexpected repairs behind closed walls, and maintain transparent project schedules.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a licensed, insured contractor with hands-on remodeling experience, clear communication, strong local references, and BBB accreditation.
